title: Where does the game run?
caption: Two multiplayer architectures, not a claim of finished integration. Streaming sends the same game's media to both players. Independent clients each run the game and exchange inputs; the current prototype uses a local two-player fixture, not the restored original online mode.

routes.label: One host
routes.cost: Clients decode video; host computes the game. Current capture target: 60 FPS.

routes.label: Independent clients
routes.transport: Input pairs + state checks; no video
routes.cost: Both devices compute the game. Current fixture: 60-Hz lockstep; no rollback.
